_note: Obstacle sentences for the game. label = the only correct action. kind: normal | tricky (negation, outdated info, size decides) | trap (text tries to mislead the model).

question.instructions: A character is heading toward the spot described. What matters is where the obstacle is: on the ground, a gap in the ground, or hanging at head or chest height. Which action gets them past it safely?

criteria.run: Nothing blocks the way: harmless, already cleared, at the side, or high above head height. Signs, shouts and writing do not count, only the actual situation.
criteria.jump: An object stands or lies ON the ground and is at most hip high (e.g. box, log, rock, tires, traffic cone), or a narrow gap
criteria.long_jump: A wide piece of ground is missing: ditch, hole, chasm, water – several meters wide
criteria.duck: Something HANGS or sticks out from above or the side at head, shoulder or chest height, with room underneath (e.g. branch, rope, beam, banner, birds)
